instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, about 8 minutes.
When the pasta is almost done, add broccoli to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta reaches desired firmness and broccoli is tender, 2-3 minutes more.
When the pasta and broccoli are done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add chicken and Alfredo sauce, then toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (454 g) jar Alfredo sauce
567 g cooked chicken (shredded)

instructions.primary_message: Return pot to medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
